title: Shipped text states what the code does, and every copy is pinned
objective: A shipped hook's text agrees with its code, and each shipped copy of an id form is pinned to the constants in `intentsvcs::id`.
body:
## Rows

Report E's Report C row K, the refusal text (missed row 20). Report E's Report C row L, the docs half (missed row 21). Two unpinned shipped copies, found by dc in Phase 0.

## Deliverables

- The refusal at `lib/templates/hooks/canon-ignore-guard.sh:210` names the probe set that the guard holds (`:80-84`). It does not name `ST9999.json`, which P30 removed from the set.
- `intent-cli/tests/shipped_prose_states_the_id_constants.rs` also pins `lib/templates/prj/_wip.md:7`, the guard's probe hex (`canon-ignore-guard.sh:81-82`) and the claim forms at `intent/docs/working-with-llms.md:512`.

## Approach

Add three subjects to the existing pin test. This is not a new test. The test finds each phrase by its text, as it does for its other subjects. The docs that do not ship stay as illustrations, and design.md records them.

## Dependencies

None.

## Risks

A pin that reads a line number breaks at the next edit to its file. Each pin reads the phrase, not the line.

## Verification

Before the bank, the builder runs clippy, critic-rust and critic-shell on its diff.

The batch decides this package: one `bin/devbin gate all` and one `bin/devbin test shell` at main's HEAD, after the last bank lands, booked by vc with the Desk. No gate and no suite runs for this bank alone.

## Seat and size

dc (shipped prose and templates). XS.
